notes: Andrew, 2026-11-08: "Need a console table for the living room, bottom left area on wall that sepaerates to kitchen. 51" wide at most, 41" tall at most (otherwise hits light switch). I need dawers, but also open space area on botom. Be mindful of Best color wood, be an experior interior designer. Use amazon only". Kept as the alternative with more storage. Fit (F-20): the bottom-left wall to the kitchen, Andrew's slot of 51" wide and 41" tall (a light switch above it); the wall's length and its distance from the stair railing are not measured. 47.24" leaves 3.76" of the 51" (under 2" a side, so it fills the slot), and 31.5" tall it stands 9.5" under his 41" line; 11.8" deep, 24" in front of its drawers (F-32) ends 35.8" off the wall. Three fluted drawers with round brass knobs and an open bottom shelf. Color (F-68): walnut-toned, a shade warmer and lighter than the JOINICE (amazon-B0G6BBFHKQ) in its photos, still a brown and not the floor's honey (F-68 (4)); square tapered legs. A side power station ("2 AC outlets, 1 USB-A port, and 1 USB-C port"): handy for phones at the way in, but live outlets at Maddie's height, so cap the unused ones. 52.9 lb; top up to 110 lb. Anchor it (F-21); an anti-tip mention on the page may belong to a related listing, so buy a strap if none comes in the box. Read 2026-11-08: $125.73, In Stock, FREE delivery Thursday, November 12; 4.4 stars (95); model DC-STB01; a 40" size with 2 drawers (B0H9S2QGYN, $89.98 on the search page) not read.
